plan.notes: Source: official Maricopa pathway-map page (https://www.riosalado.edu/degrees-certificates/applied-technology/precision-optics-level-i-5284n-ccl). Effective Term Spring 2024; catalog_year 2024-2025 derived from Effective Term. Full-time 'sequence of suggested courses' used; Rio Salado/Scottsdale are online/rolling-start so terms are numbered Term 1..N (no Fall/Spring labels). Sequence reflects the page's DEFAULT base pathway-map view (option-specific rows are hidden until a pathway option is selected). Credit ranges (e.g. '1-3') use the lower bound, per collection convention; 'X or Y' choices use the first-listed option's credits. Category mapping: core = AGEC/program area value present; major = no area value; elective = restricted/general-elective placeholders. Choices flagged choice=true.
